reviews.text: I went in in April 2025, completely desperate, no appointment had been made, we had never spoken before, I didn't even know him. They tried to convince us to put the cat to sleep in two places. He needed blood. The doctor was very kind, normal, and helpful. He explained why dog ​​blood was not good, reviewed the results, corrected it, wrote questions, and suggested what else needed to be checked. Contrary to the previous two opinions, he said to wait with that anesthesia. I am so grateful to him, we fought, and the cat is alive and well.

The doctor is incredibly kind and treats animals with great love. I have 3 little kittens, I took them all to him and I can't say anything negative. The assistant lady was also very friendly. I recommend them to everyone.

I was in the office not long ago, looking for a veterinarian friend of mine who was ordering with an interest in mind. I was greeted in an outrageous style, the assistant behaved in an extremely impolite, arrogant and downright jerky manner. If this is the style and helpfulness here, then I would not recommend it to anyone.

I took my dog's eyes to be cleaned, of course I didn't ask him if he would take it on
I wanted to explain what he told me and how to do it, to this: see you later
Afterwards of course after I told him that I had no intention of being a jerk, I just didn't understand what he was doing, and he did it
I asked nicely what I owed him: "don't come here too much"
That says it all
Pathetic

Today our puppy didn't eat or drink and didn't want to get up and so we went to the vet where they took blood from him, but we were told that we had to bring the blood to this place so that they could look at a general blood count in the emergency room. 40 minutes before closing, the kind doctor said that he was asking for 3x the price we had received when we contacted our vet and said that he wanted to talk to the "doctor" and slammed the door on us and said that someone else would examine him then. That's all about his professional knowledge, it was about a sick puppy, but after bringing the pet home in hand, we have to take the blood back to our doctor tomorrow and wait more time for the results. I don't recommend it to anyone who can avoid it

Today, December 26, 2024 at 12:30 PM, I called the Doctor. On the emergency number that Supervet gave me. An urgent hematological examination, supplemented with kidney parameters, was needed for our dog with severe kidney disease, who was discharged from the hospital on the 23rd and was treated in the hospital between December 09-23. The gentleman, who has Dr. in front of his name, started yelling at me, asking me what I was thinking, why my colleague wasn't calling, that he wouldn't talk to laypeople (I'll just whisper: he lives off laypeople), who couldn't answer 8 out of 10 of my questions. Well, I could understand that the "colleague" wasn't on duty at the time, but was with his family, even though it WAS about my dog's life. He wasn't, and he slammed the phone in my face. (We know. We wish all our dear patients and their families a Merry Christmas! Who is in the office?) So unfortunately I couldn't even tell him that with two degrees I feel qualified enough to either hand over a blood test report or send it electronically, although I think the hematology test and kidney parameters are a pretty clear direction, even without it. I won't deal with his non-existent manners. They don't give that to the doctor. Empathy would be appropriate. Anyway - I think that's what he cares about the least - the dog died. Should I wish you a Merry Christmas? You don't want it for me? No. I wish you, the patient, not to open the door to yourself! And obviously, you don't know what this means, but shame on you! As the head of an animal protection organization, I also inform the other organization leaders about today's lavish... I can't call it care... adventure?

Our vet refused to see our dog during the appointment time (last 1 hour) with reddened skin and hair falling out in clumps.
I would not recommend it to anyone.

Our dog suffers from severe anemia, they immediately and professionally started treating him and identifying the causes, he also received blood, thanks to which Dió was able to return home after 2 days. We thank them for their work, we are very grateful.
Thank you, Sir, but I am extremely sorry about that.
